name: Apollo 11
intro: Hello, I'm Neil. Buzz and I are riding the lunar module Eagle down to the Moon.
Nobody has ever walked on the Moon. No pressure!
The Sun must be LOW when we land: long shadows show us every rock and crater.
Too dark and we see nothing. Too bright and the ground looks flat as a pancake.
briefing: The computer keeps beeping and the ground below is full of boulders.
Mission control gave us five candidate sites. Four are in reach today. Choose!
fact: Apollo 11 landed with the Sun about 10 degrees up and only seconds of spare fuel.

alarm.title: Program Alarm 1202
alarm.briefing: The guidance computer is overloaded and keeps restarting! Houston says: keep going. Pick our landing site, fast!
